nodes.label: Limited Rural Travel Radius
nodes.evidence_status: Modes, road administration, canal completion, railway date, fly-boat speed, and Griffith survey are fact-checked with corrections.
nodes.rationale: Walking, pack animals, poor western roads, costly coaches, and selective waterways made travel beyond the immediate barony an event rather than routine.

nodes.label: Canals Before Railways
nodes.rationale: Grand and Royal Canal fly-boats and waterborne freight offered the premium long-distance network before Ireland's first passenger railway opened in 1834.
